scope: Prompt 17 stability fixes, actual browser verification, desktop height fix, and performance follow-up findings

completed.F01: Command errors are separated from turn retry.
completed.F02: Country/diplomacy views validate live targets during rendering.
completed.F03: Active action limit is shared at 32; legacy oversized snapshots can recover by cancellation.
completed.F04: Terminal action retention preserves recent history and retained event references without mutating snapshots.
completed.F05: Operational game loader shares leases and cleans failed/cancelled/late-start sessions.
completed.F06: Map detail retry, stale completion rejection and world resynchronization are preserved.
completed.F07: Acknowledged operating failures return to their original verification phase.
completed.F08: Input acknowledgement retains the original attempt and phase.
completed.F09: Codex client polling and RPC timers are cleaned on all exit paths.
completed.F10: Byte-preserving runtime admission/verdict/delivery index copies are explicitly traced.
completed.F11: Five retired recovery CLIs exit clearly without historical state side effects.
completed.F12: Exact diagnostic numerator before/after values use their respective original/changed rings.
completed.desktopHeight: Desktop app is no longer hidden solely because browser content height is below 720px; short-window navigation remains reachable.

relatedTests.note: Groups reuse prior successful checks; counts are not asserted to be globally disjoint.

performanceFollowUp.userSymptom: Browser remains sluggish even without interaction

tileProbe.scope: Only four existing zoom-1 tiles, no world/geometry regeneration
tileProbe.stateWriteFormula: 3 * uniqueCells + uniqueEdges; excludes additional restored/selected exact geometry work
tileProbe.note: These times do not measure MapLibre feature-state storage, paint-buffer updates, browser frame time or GPU work.

observations.note: Process observations are not per-function browser profiling; an infinite loop or leak is not established.

primaryTargets: Base front layer has no c=1 filter; opacity zero does not prevent line geometry creation.
Initial state writes reach 1288280 for the four zoom-1 tiles, including two empty exact/changed sources.
Hover scans all historically seen cells and recomputes colors.
recommendedFirstScope: Base-front c=1 filter with exact dynamic/restored front coverage.
Sparse front overrides preserving explicit false.
State writes limited to actual source members, bounded color cache and minimal hover updates.
constraints: Original source/catalog/approval bytes and hashes remain unchanged.
Territory PBF properties are empty; cell ordinal order is hash-ID order, not country-contiguous. A 247-country ordinal-range color expression would be incorrect.
A future worker-derived render property path would verify original bytes first and preserve geometry/IDs; it requires separate implementation and correctness checks.
New operational fronts, occupations, retired countries and undo/redo must remain covered by regression tests.

limitations: Performance fixes are not yet implemented.
Linux/POSIX isolated package launch is untested.
External AI interpretation and long-run performance/history testing were not exercised.
The production build checkpoint preceded the later desktop-height CSS/message change; that change was verified by live Next compilation, lint and the actual browser.
evidence: Detailed local screenshots, trace and diagnostic reports remain under ignored reports/verification/. This tracked file records aggregate results only.
